name: gas-city-workflow
description: Transactional Beads-first lifecycle and frozen report-only evidence workflows for Gas City projects.

interface.shortDescription: Orient and work safely in Gas City projects
interface.longDescription: Gas City Workflow provides a deterministic project-context capsule, journaled lifecycle transitions, and digest-bound report-only evidence reviews. It keeps Beads authoritative, preserves Aegis evidence, and applies the same lifecycle across Gas City, HPFetcher, Blog, and descriptor-based future projects without granting new permissions or calculating project verdicts.
defaultPrompt: Begin or resume this Gas City bead through the journaled project workflow
Inspect the current bead, plan, session, journal, and next safe workflow step
Freeze and validate a report-only evidence run without changing project outputs
